name: The Hive
description: End-game hidden threat. Every colony that was independent is a node of one hidden mind (the independent colonies at game start, and those an older start had already settled into an empire). A node absorbed by an empire stays a node; at a threshold of absorption, and then with a chance each year, The Chorus declares, taking every still-independent node outright and rising from inside every absorbed one.

flags.name: hive
flags.label: The Hive
flags.description: Independent colonies are secretly one mind that rises when enough are absorbed.

params.name: hiveThresholdPct
params.label: Percent of nodes absorbed that triggers the Hive

params.name: hiveRiseChancePct
params.label: Chance per year that the Hive rises once the threshold is met (%; 100 = at once)

params.name: hiveMinNodes
params.label: Minimum independent colonies for the Hive to seed

params.name: hiveMaxNodesSeized
params.label: Still-independent nodes seized outright at the trigger (cap; nearest the largest absorbed cluster first)

params.name: hiveStateMoney
params.label: Hive: state money when it rises

params.name: hivePrivateMoney
params.label: Hive: private money when it rises

params.name: hiveIncomeFloor
params.label: Hive: income floor per month (topped up to this while it lives)

params.name: hiveSmallPorts
params.label: Hive: small space ports besides the medium one (no upkeep)

params.name: hiveNavyPct
params.label: Hive: starting fleet as % of the empires' average military

params.name: hiveConstructionShips
params.label: Hive: construction ships kept working (so its AI can build mining stations)

params.name: hiveCapturedFleetMax
params.label: Hive: most warships it is handed when it wipes out an empire (the strongest; the rest are scuttled)

params.name: hiveStationCount
params.label: Hive: nearest mining stations taken from the host when none is in the colony system

params.name: hiveExistChancePct
params.label: Chance the Hive exists in this game (%; -1 = use the shared value)

params.name: hiveMinYear
params.label: Earliest year the Hive may seed, trigger or rise (-1 = use the shared value)
